newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank Q1 oper profit up 20.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank Q1 oper profit up 20.5 pct.

text.p: (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Group oper profit before provisions 1,053 up 20.5 pct
Group own-acct trading profit 223 down a quarter
Group net interest income 1,558 up 15.8 pct
Group net comission income 717 up 17.2 pct
Group balance sheet total (March 31) 471,100 up 5.1 pct
NOTE - Full name of the German bank is Commerzbank AG. Earnings and costs compare with the year-earlier period, balance sheet total and lending compare with end-1996.
Commerzbank noted that strong year-earlier own-account trading profit had to be taken into account in assessing the decline by a quarter in the first three months of 1997.
